definitions.gloss: sanitary products; menstrual hygiene products such as pads, tampons, and menstrual cups
definitions.explanation: sanitary products; menstrual hygiene products such as pads, tampons, and menstrual cups

examples.japanese: {生理用品|せいりようひん}を{買|か}う。
{生理用品|せいりようひん}は{薬局|やっきょく}やコンビニで{手|て}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: Sanitary products are available at pharmacies and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}のトイレに{生理用品|せいりようひん}を{無料|むりょう}で{設置|せっち}する{動|うご}きが{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: There is a growing movement to provide free sanitary products in school restrooms.

notes:
A compound of {生理|せいり} (menstruation; physiology) and {用品|ようひん} (supplies/products). In Japanese, {生理|せいり} alone is the standard indirect way to refer to menstruation, parallel to English "period."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生理用品|せいりようひん}の{無料|むりょう}{配布|はいふ} — free distribution of sanitary products
- {生理用品|せいりようひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} — sanitary products section (in a store)
- {生理用品|せいりようひん}を{備|そな}える — to stock sanitary products

RELATED WORDS:
- {生理|せいり}ナプキン — sanitary pad
- タンポン — tampon
- {生理|せいり}{用|よう}ショーツ — period underwear
- {生理|せいり}の{貧困|ひんこん} — period poverty (a social issue gaining attention in Japan)
